REGULAR MEETING
OF THE
CITY COUNCIL AND
REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - JANUARY 13, 2005 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
A G E N D A
Public input will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered.
1.
Call to Order
2.
Invocation
3.
Pledge of Allegiance
4.
Roll Call
5.
Presentations
6.
Public Comments and Suggestions
Consent Calendar
7.
Registers of Demands dated 1/13/2005
8.
Treasurer’s Reports for period ending 11/30/2004
9.
Minutes of 12/9/2004
10.
Ordinance for second reading and adoption.
10A.
Ordinance 890 – An ordinance of the City of Cerritos amending Chapter 22.24 of the Cerritos Municipal Code relating to the regulation of setback standards for properties located within the Commercial Office Professional (COP) zone
11.
Miscellaneous
11A.
Consideration and award of Bid No. 990-05, printing of the 2005-2006 Cerritos Center for the Performing Arts Season Brochure
11B.
A request by Cingular Wireless, LLC, to sell their interest in the sublease of the cellular phone tower located at 16449 Piuma Avenue (APN 7016-004-903) to T-Mobile USA, Inc.
End of Consent Calendar
12.
Public Hearings
12A.
Negative Declaration/Development Code Amendment 2004-9 – An ordinance of the City of Cerritos amending Chapter 22.22, Single Family Residential (RS) zones, of the Cerritos Municipal Code relating to the regulation of the height of hedges and landscape screens in residential front yards
12B.
Mitigated Negative Declaration/Development Code Amendment 2004-5 – An ordinance of the City of Cerritos amending Chapter 22.11, Development Area One (ADP-1), of the Cerritos Municipal Code as it relates to intensity standards
12C.
Cerritos Redevelopment Agency Conformity Report 2005-1/Mitigated Negative Declaration*/Conditional Use Permit 2004-3/Precise Plan 2004-5, United Parcel Service, 13150 Moore Street, APN 7005-006-061
12D.
Cerritos Redevelopment Agency Conformity Report 2005-2/Mitigated Negative Declaration*/Conditional Use Permit 80-5(B)(2004) Amendment/Precise Plan 80-10(B)(2004) Amendment, United Parcel Service (UPS), 13233 Moore Street, APN 7005-006-059
13.
Public Works Activities
13A.
Consideration of an award of contract for the construction of public improvements in Cerritos College Transit Station, Bettencourt Park, and Rainbow Park, Projects No. 49025 and 89025, Bid No. 987-05
13B.
Consideration and award of contract for the design of C-1 water well building reconstruction at 12701 Artesia Boulevard, (APN 7030-001-900), Project No. 17003
14.
New and Old Business
14A.
Consideration of a request of the League of Women Voters/Downey Area regarding its February 9, 2005 City Council Candidate Forum
14B.
Consideration of the City Council of the City of Cerritos to retain the services of a legislative advocate to act on behalf of the City of Cerritos on matters of federal interest
14C.
Consideration of recognizing the birthday of Martin Luther King, Jr. as a City holiday
15.
Report on Pending Legislation
16.
City Council Communications/Committee Reports
17.
Closed Session
17A.
Personnel matters pursuant to Government Code Section 54957.6: Conference with Labor Negotiators. Agency Negotiators: John Saunders and Denise Manoogian Employee Organization: AFSCME, Local 619
18.
Adjournment
